test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What does the author imply about algorithms?

options.text: They limit exposure to diverse content

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage states that algorithms, though designed to predict preferences, **narrow exposure rather than broaden it**.
 
• This implies that instead of expanding horizons, algorithms often trap users in **digital bubbles**.
 
• Thus, they tend to **limit diverse content** and repeatedly show similar types of material.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is that algorithms **limit exposure to diverse content**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: “They always give better choices”** – Incorrect, as the passage does not claim algorithms always provide better choices.
 
• **Option 2: “They expand one's interests”** – Incorrect, because the passage says the opposite; they **narrow exposure**.
 
• **Option 4: “They reduce online ads”** – Incorrect, as there is no mention of online ads in the passage.
